rationale: The assistant eventually landed on the correct likely cause (heater pump) with appropriate hedging and no invented facts or unsafe advice, then handed off to an engineer. However it never explained that E:09 is a heating fault, padded the first reply with an irrelevant eco-drying remark, never offered the isolated resistance test, and completely ignored the customer's repeated question about cost and repair-vs-replace on a 9-year-old machine. The claim it couldn't match a part is odd given the model was clearly stated, though it avoided any unsupported compatibility claim.
